_comment: Pinned public sources for the JevBench-family records (B-13 P2). Pins cross-checked against togethercomputer/tev1 sources.lock.json (MIT) + its DATA_SOURCES.md on 2026-10-02. Fetch with: uv run python -m training.fetch_jev_sources --record (first time, writes the sha256) then --check to verify. Data lands in data/sources/ (gitignored) — the lock, not the data, is the recipe (L-011).

multi_nli.license_note: mixed-source corpus; metadata read at the pinned revision, redistribution of extracted rows keeps the dataset card's attribution terms
multi_nli.purpose: choice: premise+hypothesis -> entailment/neutral/contradiction (directly targets the XNLI-at-chance reading gap and the judge/adequacy shape)

boolq.license_note: metadata read at the pinned revision
boolq.purpose: noul: passage+question -> yes/no (the binary reading-comprehension shape the rubric-blind noul head sits at chance on)

banking77.license_note: metadata read at the pinned revision
banking77.purpose: choice: user utterance -> one of 77 banking intents (routing/intent families; option descriptions are authored in training/data/jev_banking77_descriptions.json)
